title: Heath-Brown identities for fractional powers of $ζ$
summary: We construct finite Heath-Brown-type identities for the fractional powers $ζ(s)^{\pm a/b}$ of the Riemann zeta-function, for every reduced fraction $a/b$ with $0 0$, whenever $|α- r/q| \le 1/q^2$ with $(r, q) = 1$. The bound carries no $x^{\varepsilon}$ loss, and the same machinery gives the endpoint case of the Möbius function with an absolute constant. As applications we determine the major-arc expansion of $S_z(x, α) = \sum_{n \le x} d_z(n)e(nα)$ to arbitrary logarithmic precision for real $0 2$.
